data.summary:
Innovative and impact-driven GenAI Data Scientist with over 11 years of experience across AI/ML, deep learning, & Agentic AI solutions. Expert in designing scalable GenAI and RAG systems, enterprise AI architecture, and orchestrated multi-agent workflows for real-world business problems. Proven record of delivering advanced AI projects across finance, technology, and healthcare sectors with top firms.
KEY HIGHLIGHTS
Architected GenAI & Agentic AI solutions using LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, AWS Sagemaker, AWS Bedrock, Crew AI, Hugging face and Smart Agent SDK.
Designed & deployed multiple RAG pipelines using FAISS, Chroma, and LLMs.
Delivered scalable, explainable AI in credit risk modeling, verification systems, and fintech platforms.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into actual implementation of models, algorithms, and technologies.
Execute the product road map and planning of the programs and initiatives as defined by the product owners.
Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing.
Strong programming skills in Python.  In-depth understanding of machine learning, deep learning & natural language processing (NLP) algorithms.
Experience with popular machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.
Knowledge of containerization tools such as Docker. Experience in deploying machine learning models in production environments.

responsibilities: Designed and implemented an Agentic AI Multi Agent solution using Smart Agent SDK to automate deceased verification by replacing manual LexisNexis queries with intelligent agents.

Developed a scoring mechanism (scale of 1–10) based on discrepancies between fetched obituary data and internal records to determine verification confidence.
Implemented LoRa and local LLMs for improving efficiency.
Achieved significant improvements in efficiency & productivity by automating the transformation of business rules into development tasks.
Developed anomaly detection models reducing cost by 11%. - Built contract renewal predictive model for enterprise customers using ML/Statistical modeling.

raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
Konnectsu Software Pvt Ltd (2017 – Present) GEN AI ARCHITECT
ADV: Designed agentic AI system using Smart Agent SDK to verify deceased via LexisNexis API and internal cross-checks.
Designed and implemented an Agentic AI Multi Agent solution using Smart Agent SDK to automate deceased verification by replacing manual LexisNexis queries with intelligent agents.
Built smart agents to autonomously search obituaries and death certificates using name and SSN, extracting and cross-verifying key attributes like Name, DOB, Address, etc.
Developed a scoring mechanism (scale of 1–10) based on discrepancies between fetched obituary data and internal records to determine verification confidence.
Automated decision logic to classify cases as “confirmed” or “unconfirmed,” with the latter routed for manual review, thereby significantly reducing manual workload.
Improved operational efficiency and accuracy in the deceased verification process, minimizing false positives and reducing turnaround time for flagging inactive accounts.
Integrated the agentic pipeline with internal databases and LexisNexis APIs, ensuring seamless, real-time data exchange and streamlined compliance workflows.
Implemented LoRa and local LLMs for improving efficiency.
Story Generator: Designed RAG app with Claude 3.7 + FAISS + React + Flask to convert BRD into structured JIRA stories.
Designing & developed a Retrieval Augmented Generation pipeline with FIASS vector search, ensuring context-aware and structure story generation.
Successfully integrated AWS Bedrock’s Claude 3.7 Sonnet for AI-driven transformation of business rules into JIRA user storied, enhancing efficiency & accuracy.
Achieved significant improvements in efficiency & productivity by automating the transformation of business rules into development tasks.
Provided leadership & expertise in AI & data science, guiding the project from conception to successful deployment.
Credit Line Increase: Built TOPSIS-based triggers + customer propensity models for personalized credit allocation.
Designing & developed a robust propensity model, accurately predicting customer engagement and spending needs over a six month period, resulting in improved offer customization.
Utilized advanced machine learning techniques to train and evaluate the propensity model, achieving high accuracy and reliability in predictions.
Designing AI models for each use case, conducting exploratory data analysis, data cleaning, and visualization.
Integrate the propensity model into the CLI program, automating trigger-based decisions and improving the timing and customization offers.
GAGAN IT (2013 – 2017) ML Engineer & AI Lead Consultant
AI Platform: Led end-to-end design of financial AI platform with modules for risk scoring, churn prediction, upselling, fraud detection, sentiment analysis, and OCR pipeline.
Developed anomaly detection models reducing cost by 11%. - Built contract renewal predictive model for enterprise customers using ML/Statistical modeling.
